Brazilian GP qualifying red flagged almost immediately due to rain

Brazilian Grand Prix F1 2026 qualifying has been red flagged barely two minutes in for horrendous wet weather conditions. Rain was always a possibility and was forecast for Saturday at Interlagos, but torrential rain even as the session got underway caught out a host of cars and forced Formula 1 stewards into action.

Cold Seawater Is Supplying District Heat in Esbjerg, Denmark

Esbjerg, Denmark, is using large electric heat pumps to extract heat from the North Sea and supply its district-heating network. During a two-hour winter test, seawater entered the system at 3.3°C and left at 1.2°C. The two heat pumps consumed 19.9 MW of electricity and supplied 55.2 MW of heat at a district-heating water temperature of 90°C.
